title: Chapter 96
content:
Chapter 96

Five days later, when Zhong Yu brought his 150,000 cannon fodder army to the Northwest Battlefield, an army of 25,000 from the Edel Barbarian Tribal Alliance had already gathered on the battlefield.

The battlefield is covered with dark clouds, and a storm is about to come. During this period of time, a major war did not happen, but small-scale conflicts with less than a hundred people continued to start and end. The hot blood did not delay because of the war. And when it stopped flowing, it became even more intense because of the momentum before the storm!

Blood and corpses covered the surrounding plains for dozens of miles. Carrion-eating raptors flew down from the sky, tearing off a piece of flesh with sharp claws on a corpse, and then flew into the sky. Slowly enjoy its food.

For these carnivorous birds and other carnivorous wild animals, the soldiers on both sides are not in the mood to manage them. Their goal at this moment is to kill the enemies that may appear in front of them or around them.

In order to detect the enemy's intelligence and clear out an open place for one's own army, it will be used as the source of the next army campaign and intelligence.

The two sides either directly fought head-on, or set up traps in ambush, or all kinds of roundabout sieges. But they can survive on the battlefield that is more cruel than the frontal battlefield, and they each staged scenes of their own specialties in order to survive!

However, all these scenes of open and secret battles stopped with the arrival of Zhong Yu's army, and their respective spies also returned to the camp, because the leaders of both sides understood that next, it is the two sides that really decide the outcome of the battlefield. A large-scale legion battle, this kind of armed fight with dozens of people that can't be put on the table, has no effect on the overall situation at all.

"The final general will see His Majesty the Emperor, and my emperor is all saints!" Liu Bei and Yu Jin led a group of generals under their command to come to Zhong Yu's imperial chariot, knelt down and performed a royal ceremony.

"Get up, there is no need to perform many big gifts in the barracks!" After finishing speaking, he looked at them for a while, and saw that the faces of these generals had a lot of wind and frost after several months of fighting, and their faces became more determined. .

"How is the situation on the battlefield now, is there any change in the enemy?"

"Reporting to Your Majesty, the situation on the battlefield is relatively stable now, there is no major conflict between the two sides, and the scale of the battle is kept below a hundred people, so there is no serious problem!"

After asking about the general situation of the battlefield, Zhong Yu pondered for a while, waved his car and drove to the camp, arrived at the large tent of the Chinese army that was usually used to discuss military affairs, and started his strategic deployment after he arrived.

In the big tent, Zhong Yugao took the main seat, and the two sides were divided into civil and military. The meeting and strategic deployment of this battle began. This meeting will determine the fate and life and death of 200,000 people on both sides.

"How many troops does the enemy have, what is the level of training, what is the level of sophistication, and what are their weaknesses? Let's talk about it!" Zhong Yu opened his mouth and asked first.

"Your Majesty, after the enemy army has received reinforcements, there are now about 25,000 people on the battlefield. They are all elites who have been on the battlefield. They are brave and fearless in combat. They are sophisticated and extremely difficult to deal with!" Yu Jin, one of the two commanders, heard His Majesty the Emperor's question, quickly replied.

"As for the weakness, it is probably that their equipment is much worse than our army. Most of them don't even have a piece of leather armor to protect their bodies, and most of the weapons in their hands are made of sharp stone tools or bones. The army only accounts for 30% to 40% of him, and there are no large and powerful defense equipment, so we can take advantage of this to attack!"

Seeing that Yu Jin stopped talking, Liu Bei, who was eager to express himself, quickly interjected, interrupting Yu Jin's next words, which made Yu Jin unhappy for a while, and his complexion sank.

Is that so? So now it seems that the enemy's weapons and equipment are not as good as their own, and their numbers are not as good as theirs. The only thing they can rely on is the extraordinary power in their hands, and the gods behind them make him afraid!

Then I can take advantage of my own number of people and directly crush them regardless of loss. I don't believe that if all these 200,000 people are exhausted, they will not be able to kill the mere 20,000 barbarians.

You know, the army on my side is an elite army that has experienced countless wars and trained for several years. As for those barbarians, although they had fought many battles, they did not have any systematic training after all.

In terms of discipline, they are still much worse than themselves, but relying on their rich combat experience, they can barely support themselves in front of the general barbarian tribe conscripts!

Encountering a regular army that is not much different from them, and even has superior discipline and equipment, the gap is immediately revealed!

"Since this is the case, then, the generals will obey the order! Return to the camp immediately after receiving the order, rectify the soldiers, repair the velvet armor, and when the sun rises tomorrow, the army will go out and do not destroy the enemy's city, and vow not to return to the army!" Zhong Yu said loudly. A voice full of excitement came, causing all the generals to feel solemn and replied in unison.

"Yes, the last general will obey the order, and then return to the camp to prepare!"

Then all the generals and civil servants retreated slowly, leaving only Zhong Yu alone in the tent to think and rest quietly, there was no more sound, only the sound of Zhong Yu's breathing came faintly.

At this moment, Zhong Yu roughly thought about his strategy again, and felt that there was basically no problem, so he stopped thinking about it, and instead sat with his knees crossed, his hands on top of his knees, his body upright, his eyes closed , carrying out this set of actions expressionlessly.

But at this moment, a purple-golden air flow in Zhong Yu's body was slowly flowing, this air was filled with a noble and supreme aura, and the meridian tissues in the body gave way to each other where it passed, and then it was also contaminated by this air. The supreme majesty of a stream of air filled Zhong Yu with an awe-inspiring aura from the outside.

In addition, these meridians also absorbed those breaths one after another, and gradually strengthened. The originally immature meridians gradually became thicker, expanded and stabilized continuously.

This is the Tianyi Emperor Gong obtained by Zhong Yu when he went to the Three Kingdoms world before. The cultivation conditions of this cultivation method are extremely harsh, and the energy required for cultivation is not the spiritual energy of heaven and earth at all, but the purest energy between heaven, earth and myriad realms Luck!

Moreover, the amount of luck consumed by cultivation is extremely huge, even with Zhong Yu's current reserves of luck points, it is still somewhat unsupportable.

So far, it's just getting started and has reached the most basic and basic conditions. If you want to practice later, you don't have enough resources, that is, luck points to support it!

This couldn't help but make him extremely anxious. He finally obtained the Emperor's Technique that he could practice, but he stopped practicing because he didn't have enough luck points to provide energy!

Let him, who has already tasted the sweetness of cultivation, get used to every minute and every second of his own strength, suddenly lose the drug like taking drugs, the feeling is really indescribable!
